entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
After arguing at length, learned counsel for the applicant seeks permission of this Court to withdraw present bail application filed by the applicant u/S 483 of the Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita,
2023 in connection with Crime No.138/2024 registered at Police Station Biaora, District Rajgarh (MP) for the offence u/S 420, 409 and 506 of IPC.
Accordingly, the present application is dismissed as withdrawn.

(PRAKASH CHANDRA GUPTA) JUDGE gp Sunil vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 11 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/19626134/
